# sokol_gfx

Vendored from [floooh/sokol](https://github.com/floooh/sokol) at commit
`e9b370fc53102279547d9e0e5d5e671042563535` (zlib license).

Only `sokol_gfx.h` is required by the DonutStudio video-helper's native GPU
backend. Update the commit and header together; run the macOS
`metal_backend` test after every update.
